item.description: Healthcare providers across the Mud listening area are marking National Rural Health Day. The event celebrates rural healthcare services.

Over four hundred nonprofit leaders gathered in South Burlington for the twenty twenty-six Vermont Nonprofit Summit. The event featured sessions on AI, cybersecurity, and philanthropy. It highlighted collaboration and shared goals across Vermont's nonprofit sector.

A report says a land bank could help Vermont's housing crisis by redeveloping abandoned properties. Funding is a key question for the Legislature to consider. Essex and Washington Counties already have land banks run by a local coalition.

Addison County groups are offering Thanksgiving meal options for residents in need. These efforts aim to support those who cannot afford or prepare a turkey dinner. Assistance programs are available throughout the county this holiday season.
